mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( reservation_no, health_center_id, member_id, service_type_id, reservation_slot_id, visitor_name, visitor_phone, status, reserved_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationNo}, #{healthCenterId}, #{memberId}, #{serviceTypeId}, #{reservationSlotId}, #{visitorName}, #{visitorPhone}, 'RESERVED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.health_center_id, r.member_id, r.service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, r.reservation_slot_id, rs.slot_date, rs.start_time, rs.end_time, r.visitor_name, r.visitor_phone, r.status, r.reserved_at FROM reservations r INNER JOIN service_types st ON st.id = r.service_type_id INNER JOIN reservation_slots rs ON rs.id = r.reservation_slot_id WHERE r.reservation_no = #{reservationNo}

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.health_center_id, r.member_id, r.service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, r.reservation_slot_id, rs.slot_date, rs.start_time, rs.end_time, r.visitor_name, r.visitor_phone, r.status, r.reserved_at FROM reservations r INNER JOIN service_types st ON st.id = r.service_type_id INNER JOIN reservation_slots rs ON rs.id = r.reservation_slot_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY rs.slot_date DESC, rs.start_time DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.health_center_id, r.member_id, r.service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, r.reservation_slot_id, rs.slot_date, rs.start_time, rs.end_time, r.visitor_name, r.visitor_phone, r.status, r.reserved_at FROM reservations r INNER JOIN service_types st ON st.id = r.service_type_id INNER JOIN reservation_slots rs ON rs.id = r.reservation_slot_id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CHECKED_IN', checked_in_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
